description: Compare two versions of text side-by-side and see exactly what changed. This app highlights additions in green, deletions in red, and shows unchanged text clearly. Perfect for reviewing edits, comparing draft versions, tracking document changes, or seeing what modifications were made to your writing. Get instant visual feedback on differences between any two texts with detailed statistics on additions, deletions, and modifications.
